name: B10-0316/2026 (PfE) – Political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of Carlos Brenes and his wife Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto, and demands answers about the death in custody of indigenous leader Brooklyn Rivera. It condemns Nicaragua's government for jailing and exiling opponents, church leaders and journalists, and for a constitutional change that ended the separation of powers. It asks the European Union to stop sending money to the regime, to sanction more people close to Daniel Ortega and Rosario Murillo, and to open investigations into crimes against humanity.

- The text is a set of demands and condemnations, not a law; nothing changes yet.
- It targets Nicaragua's government, its officials and the people named above.
- Next, the Council and Commission decide whether to act on sanctions and funding.
